name: [☀️SOLAR] Elemental Battlegrounds
desc:
Fight solo or team up with friends in this action packed magic fighting game! To earn diamonds and shards, use your magics and level up! You can also find them around the map in Drop Zones and buy them in the in-game shop. Spend them on learning any new element you choose!  

Controls PC: Double tap WASD to do flips, Ctrl/Cmd to sprint, Q to punch, R to block, hold click to charge some magic moves. 
Mute music in the bottom right corner of the game menu.

STUCK IN A LOADING SCREEN? Please download Roblox from the website and do not use the Microsoft app version or this game will not load.

Follow @Elements_RBLX to vote on future elements, sneak peeks, and more!
Do not exploit, we do not appeal our bans.
